name: University of Glasgow
description:
The University of Glasgow, established in 1451 by its founder William Turnbull, is a prestigious public research university located in Glasgow, Scotland. The Glasgow university (fondly called as "Glas") has a long history and is dedicated to being excellent in academics.  With a student-to-faculty ratio of 5:1, the university prioritizes personalized and quality education. The main campus, sprawling across 85 acres in Glasgow, serves as a vibrant hub for intellectual pursuits. The university has Â£225.2 million in funds as of 2021, demonstrating its financial stability and dedication to progress. With an acceptance rate of 74%, the University of Glasgow maintains a balance of inclusivity and academic rigor. Notably, the institution demonstrates remarkable success with a graduation rate of 85.33% and an impressive employment rate of 95.9%. Currently, the University of Glasgow enrolls 26,635 students, fostering a diverse and dynamic learning community. For those seeking to explore this esteemed institution further, the official website University of Glasgow, United Kingdom provides comprehensive information. For inquiries, the university can be contacted at +44 141 330 2000, solidifying its commitment to accessibility and communication.

Itâ€™s one of the top 100 universities in the world according to both the QS World University Rankings and Times Higher Education rankings. Itâ€™s also in the top 20 UK universities according to the Complete University Guide, The Guardian and The Times/Sunday Times. According to the Research Excellence Framework 2014, 81% of the research achievements were rated as "internationally excellent", putting it in the UKâ€™s top ten universities.

Very recently, The Times & Sunday Times Good University Guide 2024 has awarded the University of Glasgow the title of "Scottish University of the Year".

What is the University of Glasgow acceptance rate for International Students?

The University of Glasgow acceptance rate is 73%.

Glasgow is a thriving and lively city to study with lots of great bars, pubs, restaurants, live music, football and shopping to keep you entertained. Itâ€™s also well-placed to explore the best of what Scotland has to offer with national parks right on its doorstep.

Student Life

The University of Glasgow has been benefitting from a Â£1 billion investment in its facilities, adding ultra-modern touches to its historic grandeur. This includes the James McCune Smith Learning Hub which has flexible learning spaces and technology-enabled resources as well as spaces for societies and clubs.

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:
Founded in 1451, the University of Glasgow is the fourth-oldest university in the English-speaking world and a prestigious member of the Russell Group. It has a world-class reputation for research and teaching, consistently placing among the top 100 universities globally.

The university is organised into four colleges: Arts & Humanities, Science & Engineering, Social Sciences, and Medical, Veterinary & Life Sciences. With a history of excellence, its alumni include eight Nobel Laureates and two UK Prime Ministers.

highlights.title: Student Life
highlights.value:
You will join a vibrant, global community with students from over 140 countries. The university features four distinct student bodies, including the Students’ Representative Council (SRC), which supports over 300 clubs and societies.

If you enjoy staying active, the Glasgow University Sports Association (GUSA) offers access to over 50 sports clubs, ranging from football to skydiving. For postgraduates, the Gilchrist Postgraduate Club provides a dedicated social and study space with its own cafe and seminar rooms.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
The University of Glasgow offers a range of residential options, with guaranteed accommodation for many full-time international students. You can choose from halls of residence and standard rooms with shared facilities.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
The main University Library is a massive resource offering millions of physical and digital items across multiple floors. It includes the Library Cafe on Level 3 for quick breaks and specialised branches like the James Herriot Library for Veterinary Medicine.

Sports
You will have access to premier facilities through UofG Sport, including gyms, exercise studios, and functional training zones. The Garscube campus specifically hosts extensive outdoor sports pitches.

Laboratories
The university is home to world-leading research hubs, such as the Advanced Research Centre (ARC) and the James McCune Smith Learning Hub, which provide state-of-the-art laboratory and teaching technology.

Cafeteria
There are numerous dining options, including The Hub Kitchen & Salad Bar in the James McCune Smith building, which offers halal, vegan, and gluten-free meals. Other popular spots include Cafe Sakura (for sushi and boba) and The Western Café in the ARC.
